comparison.objective: Hold a robot joint at its zero mark and insert a calibration pin; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually support one moving link while inserting a pin into a narrow window versus support, level, extend, and latch a long rail at front and rear posts.
comparison.success_condition: Requires joint within 1 degree, pin home, controlled motion, stillness, and release; candidate requires correct handed rail, matched rack units, full spring engagement, screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both combine support with insertion, but calibration under gravity and multi-post structural latching are meaningfully different.
